units.source_text: 大堰邸原是个寂寞的居处。

en.t: The Oi residence had originally been a lonely place to live.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子时时来此泊宿，有时也就在这里吃些点心或便饭。

en.t: But Prince Genji often came here to spend the night, and sometimes he would have a light snack or a simple meal here as well.

units.source_text: 他来此时，对外往往借口赴佛堂或桂院，并不明言专诚来访。

en.t: When he came here, he usually told others that he was going to the Buddhist hall or to the Katsura estate, and did not openly say that he was making a special visit.

units.source_text: 他对明石姬虽非过度迷恋，但也没有轻蔑之色，

en.t: Although he was not excessively infatuated with Lady Akashi, he showed no sign of looking down on her either,

units.source_text: 绝不把她当作一般人看待，足见对她的宠爱是与众不同的。

en.t: and he certainly did not treat her as an ordinary woman, which showed that his affection for her was quite exceptional.

units.source_text: 明石姬也深知公子对她异常宠爱，所以她对公子并不作僭越的要求，

en.t: Lady Akashi also knew very well that the prince favored her unusually, so she did not make presumptuous demands of him,

units.source_text: 但也不过分自卑，凡事不违背公子的欲愿，真可谓不亢不卑，恰到好处。

en.t: yet she did not humble herself too much; in all things she avoided going against his wishes, and could truly be called neither arrogant nor servile, but perfectly measured.

units.source_text: 明石姬早就听人说：源氏公子在身份高贵的女人家里，从来不如此开诚相待，总是趾高气扬的。

en.t: Lady Akashi had long heard people say that in the houses of high-ranking women Prince Genji was never so open and sincere, but was always proud and overbearing.

units.source_text: 因此她想：“我倘迁居东院，住在太接近公子的地方，倒反而与她们同化，难免受人种种侮辱。

en.t: Therefore she thought, "If I were to move to the East Wing and live too close to the prince, I would instead become like those women and inevitably suffer all kinds of insults.

units.source_text: 现在住在这里，虽然他来的次数不多，但总是特地为我而来，在我更有面子。”

en.t: Living here as I do now, even though he does not come often, he always comes especially for me, and that gives me greater dignity."

units.source_text: 明石道人送女儿入京时虽然言语决绝，但毕竟也很挂念，

en.t: When the Akashi Novice sent his daughter to the capital, his words had been resolute, but in the end he was still very worried about her,

units.source_text: 不知公子对她们待遇如何，常常派使者来探问。

en.t: and not knowing how the prince was treating them, he often sent messengers to inquire after them.

units.source_text: 听到了消息，有时忧伤叹息；但感到光荣、欢欣鼓舞之时亦复不少。

en.t: When he heard news, he sometimes grieved and sighed; but there were also many times when he felt honored, joyful, and encouraged.
